items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh while I think of it did you ever hear of a fella they called Papa Deedah Da? ... [INTERVIEWEE] This mom I know about eight or ten was piano players I just can't call his name.

ctx.x: Yeah but this little fella called Sweetie but he's still here he don't play no more piano.
Oh while I think of it did you ever hear of a fella they called Papa Deedah Da? No I didn't know. I'm not sure if he was from here or up around Shreveport or up in the Alexander.
This mom I know about eight or ten was piano players I just can't call his name.
